metadata.scope: Complete extraction of the supplied TfL station topology archive, including its National Rail and cable-car records. TfL rail and tram services account for 458 station records, 1239 platform records and 1404 service rows. The archive is a topology/accessibility inventory and may differ from live operations. Broader National Rail coverage is partial. Blank source values remain empty strings. Platform identifiers are preserved verbatim. Lines are taken from PlatformServices.Line, never inferred from platform identifiers.
